def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    print("doc:", doc.name)
    prod = doc.products
    for i in range(prod.count):
        print("product:", prod.item(i).productType)
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = des.rootComponent
    print("bodies:", [b.name for b in root.bRepBodies])
    for b in root.bRepBodies:
        bb = b.boundingBox
        print(b.name, bb.minPoint.asArray(), bb.maxPoint.asArray())
    for o in root.occurrences:
        print("occ:", o.name, [bb.name for bb in o.bRepBodies])
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    print("cam:", cam)
    if cam:
        for s in cam.setups:
            print("setup:", s.name, s.operationType, s.machine.vendor if s.machine else None)
            print(" ops:", [o.name for o in s.allOperations])
    return "ok"
